notes: Dynamic HTTP-level reproduction against the real vLLM router and middleware; the engine client is a stub because the host has no GPU. The auth decision is the real vLLM code path.

payload.state_after: marker contains proof text from /pause and /weight_checker

root_cause.note: The RL router is included without a prefix (`app.include_router(rl_router)`) and therefore mounts /pause, /resume, /update_weights, /weight_checker at the application root. vLLM's AuthenticationMiddleware only guards GUARDED_PREFIX=('/v1','/v2','/inference','/cohere'); with --api-key set, /v1/* returns 401 while these root-mounted control routes still execute. Registration is gated by VLLM_SERVER_DEV_MODE, which SkyRL and TRL force in their recipes (audit history 1.7/1.9).
